nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the number of $n \times n$ alternating sign matrices equals the Robbins product $\prod_{k=0}^{n-1} \frac{(3k+1)!}{(n+k)!}$.
nodes.title: Alternating sign matrix theorem

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, this is the collection of all $n \times n$ integer matrices that are alternating sign matrices.
nodes.title: Alternating sign matrices of size $n$

nodes.summary: For an $n \times n$ integer matrix $A$ and indices $j, k \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$, the column partial sum of $A$ at $(j, k)$ is the sum of the entries of column $j$ in rows $0$ through $k$, that is, $\sum_{i \le k} A_{ij}$.
nodes.title: Column partial sums of a matrix

nodes.summary: An $n \times n$ integer matrix $A$ is an alternating sign matrix when every entry of $A$ is $-1$, $0$ or $1$; for all indices $i, k$ the row partial sum $\sum_{j \le k} A_{ij}$ is $0$ or $1$; for all indices $j, k$ the column partial sum $\sum_{i \le k} A_{ij}$ is $0$ or $1$; every row of $A$ sums to $1$; and every column of $A$ sums to $1$.
nodes.title: Alternating sign matrices

nodes.summary: An integer $a$ is zero or one when $a = 0$ or $a = 1$. These are the values allowed for the partial sums of an alternating sign matrix.
nodes.title: Integers equal to zero or one

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the Robbins number $A_n$ is the natural number obtained by dividing $\prod_{k=0}^{n-1} (3k+1)!$ by $\prod_{k=0}^{n-1} (n+k)!$, where the division is division of natural numbers rounded down.
nodes.title: Robbins numbers

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the Robbins product is the rational number
nodes.title: The Robbins product

nodes.summary: For an $n \times n$ integer matrix $A$ and indices $i, k \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$, the row partial sum of $A$ at $(i, k)$ is the sum of the entries of row $i$ in columns $0$ through $k$, that is, $\sum_{j \le k} A_{ij}$.
nodes.title: Row partial sums of a matrix

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the signed Robbins number is the integer $(-1)^{\binom{n+1}{2}} A_{n+1}$, where $A_{n+1}$ is the Robbins number.
nodes.title: Signed Robbins numbers
